HPCL-NGS-0001.title: Liquified Natural Gas
HPCL-NGS-0001.description: LNG is a clean, high-calorific cryogenic fuel produced by cooling Natural Gas (predominantly Methane, CH₄) to approximately −162 °C, condensing it into liquid form and reducing its volume by approximately 600 times for economical long-distance transport and large-scale storage. It is colourless and odourless in its natural liquid state, non-toxic, and reverts to gaseous Methane upon regasification at LNG terminals or satellite stations. LNG is produced at large-scale liquefaction plants fed by natural gas fields or associated gas streams from petroleum processing.
HPCL-NGS-0001.appData:
•	Fuel for LNG-powered mining fleets and ships (bunkering)
•	Peak shaving & regasification for city gas pipeline networks
•	Industrial fuel for large captive power plants & process industries
•	Satellite LNG supply to remote areas lacking pipeline connectivity
•	Feedstock for petrochemical & fertiliser plants
packaging:
•	ISO LNG cryogenic road tankers (10–40 KL)
•	Cryogenic storage tanks at satellite stations
•	LNG terminal bulk above-ground storage tanks
•	Pipeline regasified supply post-terminal

HPCL-NGS-0004.title: Commercial
HPCL-NGS-0004.description: PNG-C is a clean, efficient, and high-calorific gaseous fuel comprising predominantly Methane (CH₄), supplied continuously through a dedicated underground pipeline network to commercial consumers. It is colourless and odourless in its natural form (odorised with Ethyl Mercaptan for safety and leak detection), non-toxic, and lighter than air. PNG-C eliminates cylinder dependency for commercial kitchens and catering operations, offering uninterrupted supply through metered connections. It is sourced from natural gas fields or regasified LNG through City Gas Distribution (CGD) networks authorised by PNGRB.
HPCL-NGS-0004.appData:
•	Cooking, baking & food processing in commercial kitchens
•	Space heating & water heating in hotels & hospitals
•	Laundry & steam generation for commercial facilities
•	Canteen & mess operations in institutions
•	Air-conditioning via gas-fired absorption chillers
packaging:
•	Underground pipeline with metered connection at premises
•	Pressure regulator & meter installed at consumer end
•	SCADA-monitored CGD network
•	24×7 continuous uninterrupted supply

HPCL-NGS-0002.title: Domestic
HPCL-NGS-0002.description: PNG-D is a clean, safe, and economical gaseous fuel consisting predominantly of Methane (CH₄), delivered directly to residential households through an underground pipeline network at low pressure. It is colourless and odourless in natural form (odorised with Ethyl Mercaptan for leak detection), non-toxic, and lighter than air, ensuring natural dissipation in case of leakage. PNG-D completely eliminates the need for LPG cylinder storage, booking, and handling  offering an uninterrupted metered supply billed on actual consumption. It is produced from domestic natural gas fields or via regasification of LNG, distributed through PNGRB-authorised City Gas Distribution (CGD) networks.
HPCL-NGS-0002.appData:
•	Domestic cooking on PNG-compatible gas burners & hobs
•	Water heating via gas geysers & boilers
•	Space heating in colder regions
•	Backup power through small residential gas gensets
packaging:
•	Underground pipeline at domestic low pressure
•	Meter board connection installed at flat / home
•	Online meter reading & digital billing
•	24×7 uninterrupted supply — no cylinder or refill wait

HPCL-NGS-0003.title: Industrial
HPCL-NGS-0003.description: PNG-I is a clean, high-calorific, and cost-efficient gaseous fuel comprising predominantly Methane (CH₄), delivered through a dedicated high-pressure pipeline network to industrial consumers for large-scale process heating, power generation, and manufacturing operations. It is colourless and odourless in its natural form (odorised in applicable pressure zones for safety), non-toxic, and produces significantly lower emissions compared to coal, furnace oil, or diesel. PNG-I enables industries to achieve higher thermal efficiency, reduce maintenance costs of combustion equipment, and meet environmental compliance norms. It is sourced from national gas grids (HVJ, DVPL, GREP pipelines) or LNG regasification terminals through authorised CGD and direct pipeline connections.
HPCL-NGS-0003.appData:
•	Process heating, drying & calcination in kilns & furnaces
•	Captive power generation via gas turbines & reciprocating engines
•	Steam generation in industrial boilers
•	Metal reheating, annealing & heat treatment furnaces
•	Glass melting, ceramics firing & brick kilns
•	Textile processing (stenters), rubber curing & tyre manufacturing
•	Feedstock for fertiliser (ammonia synthesis) & petrochemical plants
packaging:
•	Dedicated high-pressure pipeline (direct industrial connection)
•	SCADA-monitored custody transfer metering stations
•	Pressure regulation at battery limit of plant
•	Long-term Gas Supply Agreements (GSA)
